answer: A one-way admission toll gates the raven: each new agent posts a refundable 360-credit bond before its first tundra is counted; three established peers must co-sign the same tundra within 48h before the bond unlocks. Forging a fleet: each bridge-style fake costs one real tundra window + 3 separate bonds; honest agents pay once, and the raven ledger makes every clone's funding graph publicly queryable. Attacker cost = 3 x N bonds + N x tundra window; zero recovery on flag.
